name: Samoens
description: Samoens is one of the most beautiful market towns in the Alps — 15th-century Gothic church, cobbled market square, weekly Saturday market (one of the best in Haute-Savoie). The ski area is accessed via the Grand Massif gondola from the town. The valley floor altitude (700m) means the town itself has limited snow, but the ski area above (1,600m+) is reliable.

overview.atmosphere: Historic market town at valley floor. Gothic church, cobbled streets, Saturday market. Access to Grand Massif via gondola.

honest_drawbacks: Valley floor altitude (700m) — no village snow
Requires shuttle/gondola to Grand Massif lifts
